"""Independent read-only owner-event audit and saved-SMT replay; no Cargo/native."""
import hashlib, importlib.util, json, re, sys
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone

ROOT = Path('/Users/erik/.codex/worktrees/1598/umf')
OWNER = Path('/Users/erik/Projects/weft')
SELF = Path('/private/tmp/rule-event-astra-review.py')
if Path.cwd().resolve() != ROOT or Path(__file__).resolve() != SELF or len(sys.argv) != 1:
    raise RuntimeError('Unknown exact review invocation')
BASE = ROOT / 'docs/helix/04-build/evidence/security'
OUT = BASE / 'rule-event-astra-review.json'
LOG = Path('/private/tmp/security-rule-event-core.log')
sha = lambda b: hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
groups = [
    ('source-demands-formal', [
        'whole-capability-before-source-quantifier',
        'different-scopes-may-use-different-complete-capabilities',
        'original-use-needs-primary-original-and-application',
        'equal-marginals-cannot-substitute-scoped-edges',
        'source-correspondence-cannot-discharge-native-execution',
    ], [ROOT / 'tools/security/prove-source-demands.py',
        ROOT / 'docs/helix/02-design/spikes/security/source-demand-binding-v0.1.md',
        OWNER / 'crates/weft-core/src/security_obligation_sources.rs',
        OWNER / 'crates/weft-core/src/security_semantic_coverage.rs']),
    ('kind-completeness-formal', [
        'same-source-kinds-cannot-fragment-across-origins',
        'different-scopes-may-use-different-instance-complete-origins',
        'instance-completeness-cannot-discharge-native-evidence',
    ], [ROOT / 'tools/security/prove-kind-completeness.py',
        ROOT / 'docs/helix/02-design/spikes/security/backend-requirement-issuer-v0.2.md',
        OWNER / 'crates/weft-core/src/security_obligation_matching.rs']),
]
spec = importlib.util.find_spec('z3')
assert spec and spec.origin
solver_root = Path(spec.origin).resolve().parent
def solver_files():
    return {p for p in solver_root.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in p.parts and p.suffix != '.pyc'}
runtime_paths = solver_files()
paths = {SELF, LOG, BASE / 'rule-event-custody.json', OWNER / 'crates/weft-core/src/security_ir.rs', OWNER / 'crates/weft-core/src/security_requirements.rs', Path(sys.executable).resolve(), *runtime_paths,
         OWNER / 'docs/helix/02-design/contracts/CONTRACT-005-security-compilation.md'}
for name, laws, source_paths in groups:
    paths.add(BASE / (name + '.json'))
    paths.update(source_paths)
frozen = {str(p): p.read_bytes() for p in sorted(paths)}
prior = OUT.read_bytes() if OUT.exists() else None
historical_paths = [BASE / 'owner-events-astra-review.json', BASE / 'kind-instance-astra-review.json',
                    BASE / 'kind-completeness-astra-review.json',
                    BASE / 'scoped-obligations-astra-review.json']
historical = {str(p): p.read_bytes() for p in historical_paths if p.exists()}
import z3
assert z3.get_version_string() == '4.15.4'
formal_observations, receipt_audits = [], []
for name, laws, source_paths in groups:
    path = BASE / (name + '.json')
    raw = frozen[str(path)]
    proof = json.loads(raw)
    expected_pins = {str(p): sha(frozen[str(p)]) for p in source_paths}
    assert proof['sourceDigests'] == expected_pins, name + ': source inventory/digest mismatch'
    assert proof['status'] == 'conditional-proof-passed' and proof['sourcesUnchanged'] is True
    assert proof['nativeImplementationQualified'] is False and proof['acceptanceCasesPromoted'] == []
    assert proof['solverVersion'] == '4.15.4'
    assert [c['id'] for c in proof['cases']] == laws
    for case in proof['cases']:
        assert case['covers'] == ['US-056-AC7', 'US-056-AC10']
        for kind, expected in [('violation', 'unsat'), ('negativeControl', 'sat'), ('positivePopulation', 'sat')]:
            query = case[kind]
            assert query['result'] == expected and query['replayResult'] == expected
            ctx = z3.Context()
            solver = z3.Solver(ctx=ctx)
            solver.set(timeout=30000)
            solver.from_string(query['smt'])
            observed = str(solver.check())
            if observed != expected:
                raise RuntimeError(name + '/' + case['id'] + '/' + kind + ': ' + observed)
            formal_observations.append({'id': name + '/' + case['id'] + '/' + kind,
                'receipt': name, 'law': case['id'], 'queryKind': kind,
                'expected': expected, 'observed': observed,
                'smtSha256': sha(query['smt'].encode()), 'freshContext': True})
            del solver, ctx
    receipt_audits.append({'path': str(path), 'sha256': sha(raw),
        'lawCount': len(laws), 'formulaCount': len(laws) * 3,
        'sourceDigests': expected_pins, 'exactSourceInventoryMatched': True})
assert len(formal_observations) == 24 and len({o['id'] for o in formal_observations}) == 24
assert sum(o['observed'] == 'unsat' for o in formal_observations) == 8
assert sum(o['observed'] == 'sat' for o in formal_observations) == 16

# Review calculations and assertions qualify inspected source/test artifacts only.
rule_tokens = ['rule', 's0', 'read', 'reader']
id_bytes = json.dumps(rule_tokens, separators=(',', ':')).encode()
assert len(id_bytes) == 29
charges = [('four token visits', 4, sum(len(x.encode()) for x in rule_tokens)),
           ('encoded ID', 1, len(id_bytes)), ('retained rule-map ID', 1, len(id_bytes))]
assert (sum(c[1] for c in charges), sum(c[2] for c in charges)) == (6, 74)
log = frozen[str(LOG)].decode()
summaries = re.findall(r'^test result: ok\. (\d+) passed; (\d+) failed; (\d+) ignored; (\d+) measured; (\d+) filtered out; finished in [0-9.]+s$', log, re.M)
assert summaries == [('128', '0', '0', '0', '0')]
test_names = [
    'security_obligation_sources::tests::rule_retention_requires_exact_owner_pointer_and_independent_copy_budget',
    'security_semantic_coverage::tests::rule_event_custody_retains_both_scan_and_action_coordinates',
    'security_semantic_coverage::tests::issued_source_demands_keep_output_selfjoin_and_false_branch_ownership',
    'security_semantic_coverage::tests::issued_source_demands_match_independent_complete_fixture_map_and_exact_budgets',
]
for name in test_names:
    assert len(re.findall(r'^test ' + re.escape(name) + r' \.\.\. ok$', log, re.M)) == 1
parent_path = BASE / 'rule-event-custody.json'
parent = json.loads(frozen[str(parent_path)])
assert parent['status'] == 'private-rule-semantic-custody-tests-passed'
assert parent['summary'] == {'passed':128, 'failed':0}
assert type(parent['exitCode']) is int and parent['exitCode'] == 0
assert parent['rawOutputSha256'] == sha(frozen[str(LOG)])
assert parent['selectedPostRunSourcePins'] == {str(p):sha(frozen[str(p)]) for p in [
    OWNER / 'crates/weft-core/src/security_obligation_sources.rs',
    OWNER / 'crates/weft-core/src/security_semantic_coverage.rs']}
assert parent['freshNativeExecution'] is False and parent['promotedAcceptanceCases'] == []
expected_rule_ids = [json.dumps(['rule',scan,action,name], separators=(',',':'))
    for scan in ['s0','s1'] for action in ['read','query-original'] for name in ['reader','membership']]
observations = [
    {'id':'actual-immutable-owner-rule-custody', 'expected':True, 'observed':True,
     'method':'Read-only source inspection: private rule_events stores borrowed actual Rule pointers with coverage/context lifetime; conditions, effects, actions, target and dispositions remain on original Rule without cloning. Model dependencies remain reachable through context.'},
    {'id':'independent-rule-retention-ledger', 'expected':{'work':6,'bytes':74},
     'observed':{'work':sum(c[1] for c in charges),'bytes':sum(c[2] for c in charges)},
     'charges':[{'operation':n,'work':w,'bytes':b} for n,w,b in charges],
     'method':'Independent arithmetic for literal four-token ID; parent test has (6,74) pass, (5,74)/(6,73) refusals. No independent Rust execution.'},
    {'id':'same-pointer-repeat-and-separately-allocated-equal-rule-refusal', 'expected':True,'observed':True,
     'method':'Read-only review of direct retain_rule regression: equality and pointer-distinctness asserted before mutation; repeated original pointer accepted and equal clone refused at same ID. Only private intermediates mutate before Err.'},
    {'id':'two-scans-two-actions-two-rules-complete-occurrences', 'expected':sorted(expected_rule_ids), 'observed':sorted(expected_rule_ids),
     'method':'Read-only review of actual registered-context fixture; independent eight-ID inventory compared to issued map; each entry matches original plan pointer and singleton exact scan/action scope. Parent pass line checked.'},
    {'id':'false-branch-custody-and-golden-rule-keys', 'expected':True,'observed':True,
     'method':'Actual fixture retains And(false, original populated condition) by exact plan pointer at both self-join occurrences. Single-scan golden independently names reader and membership IDs.'},
    {'id':'legacy-ledger-and-atomic-boundary', 'expected':True,'observed':True,
     'method':'Read-only source inspection: retain_rule immediately returns on assignments None; ID encoding and retention charged before insertion; 4096 map/source bounds. No public partial inventory is returned on error.'},
    {'id':'conditional-lineage-scope-only', 'expected':True,'observed':True,
     'method':'Borrowed rule payload is not complete semantic kind/occurrence enumeration, independent template issuance, authenticated qualification, Rust refinement or native enforcement.'},
]
assert solver_files() == runtime_paths
if any(Path(p).read_bytes() != data for p, data in frozen.items()):
    raise RuntimeError('Captured input/runtime changed')
if any(Path(p).read_bytes() != data for p, data in historical.items()):
    raise RuntimeError('Historical review changed')
if (OUT.read_bytes() if OUT.exists() else None) != prior:
    raise RuntimeError('Previous owner-event review changed')
receipt = {
    'id': 'rule-event-astra-review', 'status': 'qualified-rule-event-review-passed',
    'reviewer': '/root/astra_security_review', 'generatedAt': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'sourceDigests': {p: sha(data) for p, data in frozen.items()}, 'sourcesUnchanged': True,
    'reviewCommand': {'argv': [sys.executable, str(SELF)], 'cwd': str(ROOT),
        'sourceSha256': sha(frozen[str(SELF)]), 'source': frozen[str(SELF)].decode()},
    'formalReplay': {'solverVersion': z3.get_version_string(), 'formulaCount': 24,
        'unsatCount': 8, 'satCount': 16, 'receipts': receipt_audits, 'observations': formal_observations},
    'observations': observations,
    'parentRustExecution': {'attribution': 'Parent-produced log; inspected only, not independently executed by this review.',
        'path': str(LOG), 'sha256': sha(frozen[str(LOG)]), 'log': log,
        'summary': {'passed': 128, 'failed': 0, 'ignored': 0, 'measured': 0, 'filtered': 0},
        'requiredPassLines': test_names, 'independentlyExecuted': False, 'parentReceiptPath': str(parent_path), 'parentReceiptSha256': sha(frozen[str(parent_path)]),
        'buildSourceCustodyQualifiedByThisReview': False},
    'historicalReviews': [{'path': p, 'sha256': sha(data), 'preservedUnchanged': True,
        'scope': 'Historical only; no pin refresh or freshness assertion.'} for p, data in historical.items()],
    'scope': 'Read-only review of current private borrowed rule-event custody, source identity and scan/action coordinates, pointer-conflict refusal, phase-local budgets and new isolated controls. Independently replayed all15 source-demand and9 kind-completeness saved SMT formulas in separate fresh contexts, with exact closed law IDs, outcomes and current proof source path/digest inventories. These eight finite conditional Boolean laws do not prove rule extraction, arbitrary cardinalities, Rust refinement, independently complete typed kind/occurrence or case inventories, profile authentication or native enforcement. The 128-test Rust log and selected post-run parent pins are parent-attributed only, with no complete Rust build-custody claim. No Cargo, producer or native fixture was run. Review/runtime pins cover selected audited inputs, not a complete Rust build closure. Python executable and selected complete Z3 package files are pinned; platform/dynamic system libraries remain trusted. No complete semantic issuance, release authority or backend acceptance is established.',
    'remainingFindings': [], 'nativeImplementationQualified': False, 'acceptanceCasesPromoted': [],
    'acceptanceCriteria': ['US-056-AC7', 'US-056-AC10'],
}
if prior is not None:
    h = sha(prior)
    archive = OUT.with_name(OUT.stem + '-prior-' + h[:16] + '.json')
    if archive.exists() and archive.read_bytes() != prior:
        raise RuntimeError('Archive collision')
    if not archive.exists(): archive.write_bytes(prior)
    receipt['previousReceipt'] = {'path': str(archive), 'sha256': h, 'scope': 'Historical only.'}
OUT.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'status': receipt['status'], 'formulaCount': 24, 'unsat': 8, 'sat': 16,
    'sourcePins': len(frozen), 'sourcesUnchanged': True, 'remainingFindings': [],
    'parentRustTests': 128, 'independentRustExecution': False,
    'output': str(OUT), 'sha256': sha(OUT.read_bytes())}))

observations.method: Read-only source inspection: private rule_events stores borrowed actual Rule pointers with coverage/context lifetime; conditions, effects, actions, target and dispositions remain on original Rule without cloning. Model dependencies remain reachable through context.
Independent arithmetic for literal four-token ID; parent test has (6,74) pass, (5,74)/(6,73) refusals. No independent Rust execution.

Read-only review of direct retain_rule regression: equality and pointer-distinctness asserted before mutation; repeated original pointer accepted and equal clone refused at same ID. Only private intermediates mutate before Err.

Read-only review of actual registered-context fixture; independent eight-ID inventory compared to issued map; each entry matches original plan pointer and singleton exact scan/action scope. Parent pass line checked.
Actual fixture retains And(false, original populated condition) by exact plan pointer at both self-join occurrences. Single-scan golden independently names reader and membership IDs.

Read-only source inspection: retain_rule immediately returns on assignments None; ID encoding and retention charged before insertion; 4096 map/source bounds. No public partial inventory is returned on error.
Borrowed rule payload is not complete semantic kind/occurrence enumeration, independent template issuance, authenticated qualification, Rust refinement or native enforcement.
